```{=html}
<div class="resource-page">
  <section class="resource-hero" aria-labelledby="ai-title">
    <div>
      <p class="eyebrow">Responsible Help</p>
      <h1 id="ai-title">AI and Help</h1>
      <p>AI can help you understand, debug, revise and test an idea. It does not replace your judgment: in STT-1100, what matters is your ability to verify, explain and take responsibility for the choices in your deliverables.</p>
      <div class="resource-actions">
        <a class="home-action home-action--primary" href="https://chatgpt.com/g/g-682d165f32e881918633affa3fe9dfd6-stt-1100" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open STT-1100 GPT</a>
        <a class="home-action" href="defis.html">Challenges</a>
        <a class="home-action" href="projet_session/index.html">Project</a>
        <a class="home-action" href="boite_outils.html">Toolkit</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-panel" aria-label="Responsible-use reflex">
      <div><span>1</span><p>Ask for help</p></div>
      <div><span>2</span><p>Verify yourself</p></div>
      <div><span>3</span><p>Disclose use</p></div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="uses-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="uses-title">Simple Rule</h2>
      <p>AI is a working tool. It becomes a problem if it hides your understanding, invents elements or produces an answer you cannot defend.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="principle-grid">
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Allowed</h3><p>Ask for an explanation, debugging lead, clearer wording, checklist or feedback on your own work.</p></article>
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Control</h3><p>Reuse a suggestion only after running the code, comparing it with the data and rereading the instructions.</p></article>
      <article class="principle-card"><h3>Avoid</h3><p>Submitting code, text, sources or interpretations that you do not understand or cannot reproduce.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="activity-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="activity-title">Depending on the Activity</h2>
      <p>The same tool does not play the same role in formative practice, a challenge, an exam or the course project.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="course-flow">
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">1</span><h3>Adventures, mini-tests and exercises</h3><p>Encouraged for understanding a concept, testing a command, fixing an error or finding another explanation.</p></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">2</span><h3>Challenges</h3><p>Possible as support for reasoning, debugging or revision. The final deliverable must remain verifiable, personal and consistent with the instructions.</p></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">3</span><h3>Exam</h3><p>The exact conditions, authorized materials and allowed tools are listed on Brio. When in doubt, the official instructions prevail.</p></article>
      <article class="flow-card"><span class="flow-number">4</span><h3>Course Project</h3><p>Possible for organizing work, reviewing code or improving clarity. The team must document the data, sources, analysis choices and limitations.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="trace-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="trace-title">Disclosing Help Received</h2>
      <p>When AI influences an important part of an evaluated deliverable, keep a short and clear trace. The goal is not to write a long report, but to make your process transparent.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-hub-grid">
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Tool Used</h3><p>Name the tool or GPT used, for example STT-1100 GPT.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Purpose of Help</h3><p>Indicate whether the help was for debugging, rewriting, checking, planning or finding errors.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Affected Part</h3><p>Name the section, function, graph or passage that was influenced.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-hub-card"><h3>Verification Done</h3><p>Say how you checked the suggestion: code run, Quarto render, comparison with the data, rereading of instructions.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section resource-split" aria-labelledby="limits-title">
    <div>
      <h2 id="limits-title">Before Using an Answer</h2>
      <p>A useful answer must be compatible with the instructions, the data and the code you actually ran. If a suggestion looks impressive but does not render, does not match the variables or contradicts the instructions, it should not enter the deliverable.</p>
      <ol class="clean-steps">
        <li>Reread the module, challenge or project instructions.</li>
        <li>Run the code in your own Quarto document.</li>
        <li>Check that variable names, filters, units and graphs match the data.</li>
        <li>Rewrite the interpretation in your own words.</li>
        <li>Keep a short note if the help influenced the final result.</li>
      </ol>
    </div>
    <div class="resource-compact-list" aria-label="Red lines">
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Do Not Invent</h3><p>No source, data, variable, result or citation should be added without verification.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Do Not Delegate Judgment</h3><p>AI may suggest; you must decide, test and explain.</p></article>
      <article class="resource-compact"><h3>Do Not Share Sensitive Data</h3><p>Do not send personal, confidential or non-anonymized data to an external tool.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>

  <section class="resource-section" aria-labelledby="prompt-title">
    <div class="resource-section__header">
      <h2 id="prompt-title">Useful Questions to Ask</h2>
      <p>The best prompts request targeted help while keeping responsibility for the decision on your side.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="reading-map">
      <article><h3>Debug</h3><p>Here is my error message and the minimal code that produces it. Can you help me find the likely cause?</p></article>
      <article><h3>Understand</h3><p>Explain this R output in plain language, then indicate what I should check in my data.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Revise</h3><p>Review this interpretation and flag any sentences that go beyond what the data support.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Improve</h3><p>Suggest a clearer version of this paragraph without changing the result or adding unverified information.</p></article>
      <article><h3>Test</h3><p>What checks should I run before submitting this Quarto document?</p></article>
      <article><h3>Document</h3><p>Help me write a short note describing how I used AI and how I verified the answer.</p></article>
    </div>
  </section>
</div>
```
